versions.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation
v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

Initial release – provides external knowledge retrieval for AI agents beyond training data.

- Enables AI agents to query structured external knowledge, overcoming training data limitations.
- Supports knowledge retrieval, stateless architecture, encrypted transmission, and token-based authorization.
- Designed for individual use, focusing on simple, single-query scenarios.
- Does not store or train on queried data; responses are real-time and sessionless.
- Easy setup via environment variables; suitable for technical, up-to-date, and domain-specific queries.
